purpose: Verify the rebuilt analysis-thread probe on the connected Lumia using IR-off camera activity only.

build.result: Successful; javac, D8, zipalign, and apksigner completed.
build.signing: Temporary build-only key stored under /private/tmp and not added to Git.
build.sourceState: Includes the cleanup fix that keeps frameOperationBusy set until asynchronous image analysis finishes.

irOffPreview.observed: Camera ID 2 opened, the preview session configured, and repeating capture-result callbacks continued.

oneFrameAnalysis.interpretation: The Camera2 callback handler delivered both the YUV callback and matching capture-result callback promptly while CPU analysis was dispatched to the separate analysis thread. Equal sensor timestamps associate both callbacks with frame 453; UNKNOWN timestamp source prevents comparing that sensor timestamp with elapsed-realtime.
oneFrameAnalysis.analysisSummary: Not captured. The UI hierarchy snapshot was taken shortly after the request and did not include the eventual local-only analysis summary. No analyzer completion claim is made.

analysisCompletionFollowup.workerCompletionEvent: YUV analysis worker finished; input image buffer closed.
analysisCompletionFollowup.interpretation: A subsequent build added a non-image completion log and async-error control recovery. One IR-off frame completed analysis on the separate worker; Camera2 delivered the corresponding result about 393.52 ms after request submission and 1.32 ms after the YUV callback.

limits: This verifies successful build, callback responsiveness, analysis-worker completion and image-buffer closure, not image usefulness, matcher accuracy, biometric security, or iris unlock.
The AE result reported ISO 1042, above the advertised range; no setting was changed during this IR-off preview/analysis check.
No IR emitter channel was enabled.
publication: local only; no commit, push, or PR
